Post Master’s PMHNP
Certificate

Salve Regina University’s Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) certificate is an accessible and intensive program designed for professionals who hold an M.S. in nursing and wish to transition their career to an advanced practice psychiatric mental health nurse practitioner.

Pricing

$24,630 for nurses from partner institutions. $26,070 for nurses from non-partner institutions.

Flexibility

Complete the Post Master’s PMHNP program in as little as 24 months — 30 credit hours and 750 clinical hours.

Benefits

Preferred tuition rate for nurses at partner institutions extends to spouses and family members as well as members of the military.

*Pricing reflects cost of nursing curriculum only

Program Benefits

Our psychiatric mental health nurse practitioner program is delivered online in a thoughtful blend of synchronous and asynchronous class meetings. A 40-hour skills-based colloquium on Salve Regina’s campus is also required. This combination offers the flexibility required for working adults while also fostering personal connections with faculty that are the hallmark of the Salve Regina experience.

Salve Nursing

Founded by the Sisters of Mercy in 1934, Salve Regina University is a Catholic institution known for excellence in learning and fueling the imagination of students to bring forward progressive ideas that marry intellect and spiritual growth.

We enroll nearly 2,700 undergraduate and graduate students from across the globe. Our programs are designed to support a world that is harmonious, just and merciful by integrating student experience and personal values with competency in theory and in practice.

  • Financial aid is available
  • Join our program to discover the difference Salve can make in your personal and professional life
  • Opportunities for professional development within a holistic model of education backed by the Mercy Mission
  • Preparation to address future health needs of various populations

Nursing Curriculum

Salve Regina University welcomes you! Our online MSN with a Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner concentration and our Post Graduate PMHNP Certificate are accredited by the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education, and through it you will explore innovative learning opportunities focused on making a positive impact on others.

Working toward your PMHNP certificate highlights your leadership skills and empowers you to encourage others to embrace healthy living and social justice. Upon graduation, you will join other nursing professionals who advocate daily for the well-being of individuals, families and the communities in which they live. Ready to make an impact? Apply to Salve Regina University’s fully online PMHNP certificate today.

Required Courses

NUR542Advanced Psychopharmacology Across the Lifespan
NUR546Psychiatric Mental Health NP I
NUR558Psychiatric Mental Health NP II
NUR568Psychiatric Mental Health NP III
NUR570Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner Clinical I
NUR575Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner Clinical II
NUR580Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner Clinical III

The 3 foundational prerequisite courses are required for non-APRN applicants: Pathophysiology, Pharmacology, and Physical Assessment.
